title: German-Style White Bean and Spinach Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew that combines German flavors with the freshness of spinach and beans.
instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the beans and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the robust and refreshing and stir to combine.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the spanakopita and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional spinach if desired.
